method: Read-only reconciliation against the mounted Master Library and the committed corpus index. All 499 corpus files were rehashed in this lane, so a pinned digest is answered by search rather than by lookup, and every bound digest was recomputed from bytes. Two binds were settled by opening the held document rather than by reading its name. Nothing was fetched.
scopeLimit: SOURCE_IDENTITY_FINDINGS SIF-4: private/Nationwide Record Clearing/ is absent from this worktree. Where a source is recorded held there, this lane reports it unreachable rather than missing.
releaseNote: Empty. Four Arkansas families have both halves of their petition-and-order pair bound here, which is closer than any other family in this worker's lanes, and their release still waits on obligations outside SRC04.
grantsNothing: A bound source is a bound source. It builds nothing, proves nothing and approves nothing.
